# Reference images: sources and licences

The real raster fixtures of the trace reference set (`specs/0089-trace-quality-and-colour`
criterion 1, Frage 82 default: synthetic plus CC0 or public domain only). Every file here was
retrieved from Wikimedia Commons on 2026-10-29; its licence was checked on the file page (the
`CC0` licence template and the "CC-Zero" category; `ai-pocket-theft` also carries the
`PD-algorithm` tag). Each image was resized to at most 640 px on its longest side with ImageMagick,
metadata stripped, JPEGs re-encoded at quality 92; CC0 and public domain allow this without
conditions. Each image has a JSON sidecar beside it with its group, intended use, what the trace
must preserve, the resolution assumed for the harness, the origin, author, licence and the
modification.

The customer's own images never go here: the harness reads them from the directory named by
`CURVYO_TRACE_LOCAL` and stores only their numbers as `local.<hash>` in `baseline.json`.

## The customer's reference images

31 images added by the customer on 2026-10-29, all CC0 1.0 (the customer, 2026-10-29):

- openclipart.org, CC0 1.0: `135061.png`, `181389.png`, `203337.png`, `233875.png`, `322003.png`,
  `354704.png`, `4066.png`, `61741.png`, `couple_umbrella.png`, `elephant.jpg`, `loewe.png`,
  `pferd.png` (the customer: "most images are from openclipart.org").
- Logos generated by the customer with AI, CC0 1.0: `balance.png`, `blütenzeit.png`,
  `precision.png`.
- The customer's own work, CC0 1.0: `dog_lines.png`, `dog_picture.png`, `ladybug.png`,
  `book_butterfly.png`.
- Scans made by the customer on 2026-10-29, CC0 1.0: `scan.jpg`, `scan_20261029165757.jpg`,
  `scan_20261029165800.jpg`, `scan_20261029165803.jpg`.
- Phone photos made by the customer on 2026-10-29, CC0 1.0: the eight `20261029_*.jpg`.

They stay where the customer put them, `tests/assets/trace-references/` at the repository root; the sidecars in `customer/`
point to them, and the harness decodes them in place (reduced by area averaging to at most
2000 px on the longest side). Groups: paper photo (the eight `20261029_*.jpg` phone photos of
printed drawings on a desk), paper scan (the four `scan*.jpg`), line drawing, sketch (the pencil
drawings and `dog_lines.png`), clipart and logo (`graphics`, `logos`) and one photo
(`dog_picture.png`). "Visual check" in a sidecar marks what the numbers cannot judge.
